name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted audio transcription with speaker diarization, AI summaries and chat over recordings, using an OpenAI-compatible or self-hosted speech API.

alerts.message: Transcription and summaries need an external API. Replace TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY and TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY (OpenAI by default; any OpenAI-compatible service or a self-hosted ASR endpoint works) and redeploy before uploading audio.

Sign in with ADMIN_EMAIL (admin@example.com unless you change it before the first deploy) and the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. Public registration is disabled; the admin creates other users.
